text: Attempt 2: compact layout so homes sit next to jobs. Bands top to bottom: homes, shops, factories, shops, homes; cross streets every 10 tiles; power lines through every band.
Avenue x=76 to the north edge + neighbor link, 6 streets (y=20..55), cross streets x=86/96/106, coal plant next to the factory band, 6 riverbank pumps, pipes under every band.
Shops in the rest of both shop bands; 9 more riverbank pumps (water spare capacity was 21%).
